set.body: M2/M3 integration gate: every required row of docs/EYESIM_CAPABILITIES.md through coherent public workflows. Counts come from tools/r-parity/check_baseline.py (--list-cases), not from prose. Plan: docs/plans/EYESIM_BASELINE_PLAN.md (2026-09-18) with the owner's scope decisions: eyesim bugs are fixed in eyesim and the pin moved once; R is never a workflow step; native least squares via a small hand-rolled QR; surface decomposition's baseline slice is OLS (NNLS/simplex/partial association split to bd-01M2T3ZCY7HJNFQ5G0Z6MQND0A); fitted density transforms are out of baseline; exact EMD is an intentional divergence. Exit: all three public journeys pass supported-runtime scientific gates, check_baseline reports zero implementation gaps, and v-parity's zero-gap regeneration run passes.
